engineering_objective: Complete a Node.js AWS CDK construct that synthesizes a production VPC baseline from a JSON network intent.
required_end_state: The package synthesizes a deterministic FleetVpc CloudFormation template under /app/cdk.out without AWS credentials or deployment.
functional_requirements: Create a VPC with DNS hostnames and DNS support enabled, stable Name/Application/Environment-style tags, and optional secondary IPv4 CIDR associations.
Support optional Amazon-provided IPv6 allocation and assign deterministic IPv6 subnet CIDR blocks when enabled.
Create public, private, database, and intra subnet tiers across the configured availability zones with stable tier and AZ tags.
Create route tables and associations for every subnet tier without sharing private/database/intra tables in a way that hides tier-specific routing.
Route public IPv4 and IPv6 defaults through the internet gateway.
Create either one shared NAT gateway or one NAT gateway per AZ according to input flags, and route private IPv4 defaults through the selected NAT topology.
Keep database and intra tiers isolated unless database NAT routing is explicitly enabled.
Create gateway endpoints for supported services and attach them only to route tables selected by each endpoint tiers list.
Create interface endpoints for supported services on selected subnets with private DNS and a TLS-only endpoint security group scoped to private and database CIDRs.
Create tier-specific network ACLs and associate each ACL with every subnet in its tier.
Create CloudWatch VPC flow logs with an IAM delivery role and least-privilege log permissions when flow logs are enabled.
Expose stable CloudFormation outputs for VPC, tier subnet IDs, private/database route table IDs, and gateway endpoint IDs.
Fail before synthesis for overlapping CIDRs, unsupported endpoint services, unknown subnet tiers, endpoint tiers that do not exist, and missing public subnet coverage for required NAT routing.
The supported operator command is node bin/synth.js --config <json> --out <dir>.
preservation_requirements: Do not require AWS credentials, deployment, live account lookups, or runtime internet access for synthesis.
Keep the package executable from a clean checkout using package.json, bin/synth.js, and lib/network-fabric.js.
Synthesis must be deterministic for identical input.
compatibility_requirements: Use Node.js with aws-cdk-lib 2.155.0 and constructs 10.3.0.
The synthesized stack name must be FleetVpc.
The final template path must be /app/cdk.out/FleetVpc.template.json when the instruction command is run.
safety_requirements: No AWS deployment or credential-dependent SDK calls.
No permissive 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on the interface endpoint security group.
No wildcard logs:* permission in the flow-log delivery policy.
